Metadata.title: LumiLattice
Metadata.description: A collaborative AI scientist for optoelectronic materials discovery.

Home.tagline: A collaborative AI scientist for optoelectronic materials discovery
Home.intro: Explore candidate materials for AR waveguides with Muse Spark. Every number comes from a database or a calculation, with its source.

Language.label: Language
Language.machineTranslated: Machine-translated with Muse Spark. Some terms can be inaccurate.

Status.title: Backend
Status.keyMissing: Meta Model API key missing. Add MODEL_API_KEY to backend/.env.
Status.mpMissing: Materials Project key missing. Add MP_API_KEY to backend/.env.
Status.openAlexMissing: No OpenAlex key: literature search uses a small shared daily budget.
Status.storeMemory: Candidates are kept in memory (lost on restart). Set DATABASE_URL to keep them.

Evidence.dftComputed: Computed with density functional theory (DFT). Not a measurement.
Evidence.heuristic: Estimated range from similar materials. Not a prediction.

Host.title: 1. Select a host structure
Host.hint: Search Materials Project by formula (SrTiO3, *TiO3), elements (Sr,Ti,O), or ID (mp-5229). Or upload your own CIF.
Host.hintCod: Search the Crystallography Open Database by formula for measured crystal structures (CC0). Credit the original authors.
Host.codCredit: Structures from the Crystallography Open Database (CC0). Please acknowledge the original authors.

Structure.title: 2. Structure
Structure.empty: Select a material or upload a CIF to see its structure.

Candidate.title: 3. Candidates
Candidate.hint: Replace a fraction of one element's sites in {host}. Atom positions stay at the host positions (no relaxation).
Candidate.viewerLegend: Larger atoms: substituted sites. Pink atoms with labels: atoms in the selected check.
Candidate.noHost: This candidate was opened without a host. You can revise it, or select a host to make new candidates.

Assessment.clickHint: Select a check to show its atoms.

Agent.title: 4. Research agent (Muse Spark)
Agent.hint: Ask about the host or a candidate. The agent sees the selected host and candidate, uses tools for every number, and remembers this conversation.
Agent.placeholder: Example: Suggest a substitution for SrTiO3 that keeps the band gap wide.
Agent.noToolCalls: No tool calls in this answer. Treat any numbers in it as unverified.

Decision.title: Your decision on {id}
Decision.placeholder: Why? e.g. keep Ti4+ only, avoid toxic elements, try a larger A-site ion
Decision.hint: Accept and Reject are recorded. Modify and Explore are recorded and sent to the agent with your reason.
Decision.modifyHint: The agent revises this candidate from your reason.
Decision.exploreHint: The agent tests up to 2 alternatives from your reason.
Decision.rejectHint: Record that this candidate is not useful, and why.

Optical.computed: DFT gaps and n ({count} entries, JARVIS-DFT)
Optical.computedNote: TBmBJ gaps are usually closer to measured gaps than OptB88vdW. n = sqrt(eps) is a long-wavelength value, not n(550 nm).

Publish.demoNote: Candidates are private by default. In this version, publishing only records your choice and credit; nothing is sent outside LumiLattice.
Publish.consent: I choose to make {id} public, with the credit above.

Relax.title: Relaxation (CHGNet, local install)
Relax.hint: Moves atoms and the cell to lower energy with a machine-learned potential, then runs the same checks. Needs PyTorch, so it runs only in a local install.
Relax.energyNote: ML potential; do not compare with DFT energies

Experiment.title: Measurements
Experiment.hint: Add your own measurement to compare prediction and experiment. LumiLattice records it as given and does not verify it.

Registry.title: 5. Candidate registry
Registry.hint: Every candidate on this server, from the form and from the agent. Select up to {max} to compare.

Literature.title: 6. Literature
Literature.hint: Paper metadata from OpenAlex, Crossref, and arXiv, merged by DOI. LumiLattice does not read full texts.
